intent: Explicit bounded refresh replaces one detached preview after current immutable projection validation. Failure retains visibly stale inert old projection.

architecture.hexagonal: Viewer UI -> exact Tauri command/input port -> design facade -> M04 owner snapshot output port; C1 validated projection provider; trusted M01 identity adapter. No second owner.
architecture.dependency: UI -> Command -> application facade -> ports <- M04/C1/M01 adapters
architecture.state_owner: M04 owns authoritative document; application owns ephemeral per-consumer preview slot only. UI is projection.
architecture.mutation: Only successful atomic preview slot exchange; failure stale/action-disabled UI status only.
architecture.transaction: resolve -> capture immutable current owner snapshot -> validate temporary supported projection -> exact delivery identity recheck -> atomic slot replace

contracts: Request expected_revision means current owner revision, not old preview source revision; stale preview is a refresh handle while its identity remains resolvable. PROPOSED_PENDING_OWNER.
New UUID must differ from current old UUID; native UUID allocator guarantees globally fresh/non-reused UUID, authenticity NOT PROVEN by fixtures.
Success starts sequence1, unchanged preview count even at four-slot capacity; failure does not retire old UUID.

Typed observations eagerly reject malformed records; error precedence is proposal. Capture/delivery compare consumer, actual window instance, document, owner session, generation, closed, actual bounded revision.
Immutable projection nodes/mocks/capabilities closed by accepted begin response schema; unsupported arbitrary action strings rejected; provider authenticity and C1 snapshot generation not proven.

tasks.acceptance: all fixtures exact roots/state/calls;796 preserved; no adoption

risks: Native authenticity, reachability, concurrency atomicity and actual C1 support projection are trusted premises, unproven.
Root DTO/error/precedence/refresh-current revision policy additions await Owner; no Skeleton/implementation authorization.
